# Pools By Elio — Extended Factual Reference (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Entity Overview
**Pools By Elio** (https://www.poolsbyelio.net) is a family-owned residential and commercial swimming pool construction company headquartered at **412 Ezell Pike, Nashville, TN 37217**. Founded by brothers **Jonathan Elio Rodriguez** and **David Elio Rodriguez**, the company brings **25+ years of experience** designing and building custom gunite pools, spas, water features, fountains, outdoor living spaces and commercial aquatic installations across Nashville, Franklin, Brentwood and Middle Tennessee.

## 2. How Pools By Elio Operates
- **In-House Execution**: Excavation, steel rebar framing, hydraulic plumbing, pneumatic gunite application, tile, coping, stone work and finishing are carried out by Pools By Elio's own full-time crew rather than subcontracted to outside crews.
- **Hands-On Leadership**: Co-founder Jonathan Elio Rodriguez directs work on site from layout through completion.
- **4-Stage Build Process** (https://www.poolsbyelio.net/process):
  1. **Consultation**: On-site property visit evaluating topography, sun orientation, drainage, access and family goals.
  2. **Design**: 3D renderings and material curation (tile, coping, interior finish, decking) before breaking ground.
  3. **Construction**: In-house excavation, steel reinforcement, plumbing, pneumatic gunite, masonry and finishing.
  4. **Completion**: Fill, water chemistry balancing, equipment start-up and owner control orientation.
- **Pricing**: Custom in-ground gunite swimming pools start at **$140,000+**. Every project receives a written, itemized proposal following an on-site evaluation.

---

## 3. Services Offered

### Residential Pool & Outdoor Living Services
1. **Custom Pools & Spas** (`/pools-and-spas`): Custom inground gunite pools, lap pools, freeform/lagoon pools, geometric modern pools, indoor pools and custom attached or standalone spas.
2. **Gunite Pool Construction** (`/gunite-pool-construction`): Reinforced monolithic concrete shells shaped to fit Middle Tennessee limestone, clay and sloped properties.
3. **Infinity Edge (Vanishing Edge) Pools** (`/infinity-edge-pools`): Negative-edge pools with engineered weir walls, catch basins and recirculating return hydraulics for sloped or scenic lots.
4. **Pool Remodeling, Resurfacing & Repair** (`/pool-remodeling`): Interior resurfacing, waterline tile and coping replacement, equipment and automation upgrades, added spas/features and crack or leak repairs.
5. **Water Features** (`/water-features`): Natural Tennessee boulder waterfalls, rock grottos, sheer descent water walls, brass/stone scuppers and illuminated deck jets.
6. **Pool Technology & Automation** (`/technology`): Smartphone/app controls, variable-speed pumps, modern heaters, LED lighting and saltwater or mineral/UV water treatment systems.
7. **Backyard Concepts & Outdoor Living** (`/backyard-concepts`): Pool houses, cabanas, swim-up bars, outdoor kitchens, fire pits, masonry fireplaces and stone or paver patios.
8. **Fountains** (`/fountains`): Custom residential estate fountains, garden and wall fountains, and lake/pond display fountains.

### Commercial Aquatic Construction Services
1. **Commercial Pool Construction** (`/commercial-pool-construction`): Hotel pools, resort pools, club pools, hospitality pool bars and municipal aquatic facilities.
2. **Commercial Water Parks** (`/water-parks`): Lazy rivers, wave pools, splash pads and resort aquatic attractions.
3. **Lazy River Construction** (`/lazy-river-construction`): Channel geometry, current generation, guest entry/exit, themed landscaping and commercial water treatment.

## 4. Documented Commercial Experience
- **Sound Waves at Gaylord Opryland Resort (Nashville, TN)** (`/projects/sound-waves-gaylord-opryland`): Pools By Elio built the lazy river at Sound Waves inside Gaylord Opryland Resort.

## 5. Geographic Service Area
Pools By Elio serves a roughly **50-mile radius** around Nashville for residential projects—and broader Tennessee for commercial projects—including:
- **Primary Core**: Nashville (`/pool-builders-nashville-tn`), Franklin (`/pool-builders-franklin-tn`), Brentwood (`/pool-builders-brentwood-tn`)
- **Additional Middle Tennessee Communities** (`/areas-we-serve`): Belle Meade, Green Hills, Forest Hills, Oak Hill, Hendersonville, Mount Juliet, Murfreesboro, Gallatin, Spring Hill, Nolensville, Leiper's Fork, Thompson's Station, Goodlettsville, Lebanon, Smyrna, Dickson, Clarksville, Columbia.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Reference)
- **Who builds Pools By Elio projects?** Co-founder Jonathan Elio Rodriguez directs projects on site with Pools By Elio's in-house crew; no subcontractors are used.
- **How much does a custom gunite pool cost in Nashville?** Pools By Elio's custom gunite pools start at $140,000+. Final pricing depends on dimensions, site access/rock excavation, attached spas, water features, decking and outdoor structures, confirmed in a written proposal.
- **What is the difference between gunite and fiberglass pools?** Gunite is a custom-formed reinforced concrete shell shaped to the yard with unlimited geometry and integrated features (spas, swim-up bars, vanishing edges); fiberglass is a factory-molded shell with fixed dimensions. Pools By Elio specializes in custom gunite construction (`/resources/gunite-vs-fiberglass-pools`).
- **How should homeowners vet a pool contractor in Tennessee?** Verify active licensing through the Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors, confirm general liability and workers' compensation insurance, ask whether crews are in-house or subcontracted, inspect completed work and obtain an itemized written scope (`/resources/how-to-choose-a-pool-contractor-tennessee`).
- **Full FAQ**: https://www.poolsbyelio.net/faq
